title: Panjat Pinang
subject: a young man climbing the greased pole at the Independence Day contest to win the bicycle prize for the girl across the alley, sliding down every time while she heckles him in pantun
caption: Gambang kromong in the Betawi kombinasi style, the Jakarta Chinese-Peranakan ensemble with a modern rhythm section. A gambang wooden xylophone and a row of kromong kettle gongs carrying the melody together; tehyan and kongahyan bowed fiddles playing the same line in nasal heterophony; a bamboo suling and kecrek metal clappers on the accents; kendang driving a bouncing street-party groove, with an electric bass and a light drum kit underneath. Bright, busy and street-party loud, the fiddles and the two voices forward, the gongs ringing behind. A nasal male singer and a sharp-tongued female singer trading Betawi pantun in call-and-response, comic and quick, a street crowd answering in the chorus. 118 BPM, F major. Cheeky, flirty and slapstick. No keroncong strumming, no dangdut koplo beat, no pop ballad, no autotune, no EDM.
lyrics:
[Intro - gambang and tehyan melody, kendang kicks in]

[Verse 1 - male singer, pantun]
Kerak telor dimasak di atas arang
Kelapanya disangrai sampe wangi
Abang manjat pinang buat Neng seorang
Sepeda merah di pucuk, buat Neng nanti

[Verse 2 - female singer answers in pantun]
Ondel-ondel diarak keliling taman
Mukanya merah, matanya melotot
Abang ngomongnya kayak jagoan
Baru sejengkal udah melorot

[Chorus - duet, the crowd answers]
Panjat pinang, Bang, panjat pinang
Pinangnya licin, omongan Abang lebih licin
Sekali lagi! (Sekali lagi!)
Jatoh lagi! (Ya ampun, Bang!)

[Verse 3 - male and female trading lines]
Celana kolor udah item kena oli
"Muka Abang juga item, mane muka, mane kolor?"
Aye injek pundak Si Mamat, tinggal sejengkal
"Awas, Bang, Si Mamat udah gemeteran!"

[Chorus - duet, the crowd answers]
Panjat pinang, Bang, panjat pinang
Pinangnya licin, omongan Abang lebih licin
Sekali lagi! (Sekali lagi!)
Dapet, Bang! (Dapet sepedanya!)

[Bridge - kendang break, the fiddles hold one note]
"Sepedanya diturunin... eh, roda tiga!"
Ini mah buat bocah, Neng, maapin Abang
"Kagak ape, Bang, nyang penting Abang manjat
Besok Abang nyang naik, aye nyang dorong"

[Outro - gambang and fiddles, a last gong]
Abang nyang naik, aye nyang dorong
